faq.title: Questions and answers
faq.a1: Everything you add is seen by both of you. An «Only me» entry is yours alone, and a surprise only shows up for your partner on the chosen day — the server itself checks this, not just the app.
faq.q2: How do I invite my partner?
faq.a2: Settings → Invitations → «Send your partner an invite». They open the link, sign in — and you're one couple. The code can also be typed in.
faq.a3: Yes. Everything is saved on the phone and sent as soon as you're back online.
faq.a4: Add the app to your Home Screen, open it from there and turn notifications on in Settings. On iPhone, iOS won't let them through otherwise.
faq.q5: What are the flame and the mascot?
faq.a5: Every day you do something together, the flame keeps burning and the mascot grows. Freezes cover missed days, and trips pause the flame on their own. You can switch it all off in Settings.
faq.a6: Themes, atmospheres, mascots, scenes, postcards and savings designs. Some are open right away, the rest open over time or are bought once — for both of you at once.
faq.a7: Yes: Settings → Data → «Export to file». You get a file with all your entries.
faq.q8: How do I delete my data?
faq.a8: Settings → «Delete my data». Your private entries are deleted and you leave the couple; if nobody else is left in it, everything is deleted.
